hooks.name: Session Start Context
hooks.description: 新 session 開始時自動顯示專案狀態：最近 git log、測試結果摘要、預算檔存在性

action.command: cd /Users/yinghaowang/HurricaneSoft/trustforge && echo "=== TrustForge Session Context ===" && echo "--- Recent commits ---" && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null && echo "--- Test status ---" && .venv/bin/pytest tests/ -x -q --no-cov --timeout=30 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo "--- Pipeline health ---" && python -c "import importlib.util; mods=['src.trustforge.bedrock','src.trustforge.trust.scoring','src.trustforge.agent.orchestrator']; [print(f'  {m}: OK') if importlib.util.find_spec(m.replace('src.','').replace('.','/').split('/')[0]) else print(f'  {m}: MISSING') for m in mods]" 2>/dev/null || echo "  (check skipped)"
